retrieved_note: Re-verified 2026-09-23 against the Jul-Dec 2026 Conventional Schedule of Charges (pk-conventional-schedule-of-charges-english-h2-2026.pdf, effective 1 Jul-31 Dec 2026, p.19 Mastercard Credit Cards), the Jul-Dec 2026 Saadiq Schedule of Charges (pk-saadiq-schedule-of-charges-english-h2-2026.pdf, p.23), the H2-2026 SOC Summary of Changes (pk-soc-summary-of-changes-h2-2026.pdf), CCPL_MID.pdf (now SCBCPRMIDV014072026, dated Jul 2026, embedded Credit Card Summary Box Tables 1-2), Saadiq Credit Card MID (now SCBPLSAADIQMID-CC&PF-14072026), pk-annual-fee-reversal-criteria.pdf (effective 1 Jan 2026, unchanged) and the live sc.com/pk product and apply-now pages (salary and age thresholds unchanged). SOCs located via the sc.com/pk/help/download-centre/ page. The standalone CC_Summary_Box.pdf still linked from product pages is a Jan-2024 document (SCBCPRMIDV123012024, promotion expired 29 Feb 2024) whose fees are superseded; it was dropped as a source.

requirements.annual_fee_waiver_rule: First-year fee reversed on spending PKR 200,000 (or 70% of card limit, whichever is lower) within 3 months of issuance; first-year fee also reversed on digital acquisition and supplementary first-year fee waived (promotions valid till 31 Dec 2026). Second year onwards: 1.5x credit limit in 3 months after fee charge, capped at PKR 800,000 and floored at PKR 200,000. Waived for Priority Banking clients while Priority criteria are met; first-year waiver for Employee Banking and Premium Banking.

notes: Re-verified 2026-09-23 against Jul-Dec 2026 SOC: annual fee Rs. 20,000 (was Rs. 14,000), supplementary Rs. 9,000 (was Rs. 5,000); first-year reversal spend PKR 200,000 or 70% of limit (was PKR 125,000). Same figures in CCPL_MID Summary Box Table 1/2 (SCBCPRMIDV014072026). Salary PKR 300,000 unchanged on apply-now page.

Apply-now page surfaces explicit Minimum Monthly Salary / Income: PKR 300,000 (corrected from previously recorded PKR 50,000).
Self-employed minimum age is 25 per the product page.
No deposit/balance threshold surfaced for this unsecured credit-card product.
